name: ym-connect
description: Local, authenticated Android control for Yandex Music playback in desktop browsers.

scripts.generate:check: pnpm protocol:generate && git diff --exit-code -- shared/generated shared/protocol/descriptor shared/protocol/fixtures
scripts.protocol:generate: pnpm protocol:descriptor && buf generate --template shared/protocol/buf.gen.yaml && pnpm --filter @ym-connect/protocol-fixtures generate
scripts.format: pnpm dlx @biomejs/biome@2.5.6 format --write --files-ignore-unknown=true . && pnpm dlx markdownlint-cli2@0.23.2 --fix
scripts.format:check: pnpm dlx @biomejs/biome@2.5.6 format --files-ignore-unknown=true . && pnpm dlx markdownlint-cli2@0.23.2
scripts.lint: pnpm protocol:lint && pnpm lint:js && pnpm lint:workspace && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:android && pnpm spellcheck
scripts.build: pnpm protocol:build && pnpm build:js && pnpm build:rust && pnpm build:android
scripts.test: pnpm test:js && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:android
scripts.check: pnpm generate:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.protocol:descriptor: protoc -I shared/protocol/proto --include_imports --include_source_info --descriptor_set_out=shared/protocol/descriptor/ymconnect-v1.pb shared/protocol/proto/ymconnect/v1/capabilities.proto shared/protocol/proto/ymconnect/v1/common.proto shared/protocol/proto/ymconnect/v1/connector.proto shared/protocol/proto/ymconnect/v1/control.proto shared/protocol/proto/ymconnect/v1/errors.proto shared/protocol/proto/ymconnect/v1/player.proto shared/protocol/proto/ymconnect/v1/session.proto && node --input-type=module -e "import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'; import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; const path = 'shared/protocol/descriptor/ymconnect-v1.pb'; const digest = createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(path)).digest('hex'); await writeFile(path + '.sha256', digest + '  ymconnect-v1.pb\n');"
